description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's sparse checkout and sparse index features. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and validation steps to verify the correctness and behavior of sparse checkouts, sparse indexes, and related Git commands in various scenarios.

methods.name: init_repos
methods.description: Initializes three separate repositories with the same initial commit, sets up sparse-checkout definitions and configurations, and prepares the environment for subsequent tests.

methods.name: init_repos_as_submodules
methods.description: Initializes repositories as submodules in a superproject, setting up sparse checkout for submodules.

methods.name: run_on_sparse
methods.description: Executes a given git command within the sparse-checkout directory, feeding input from a predefined file.

methods.name: run_on_all
methods.description: Executes a command in full-checkout and then within sparse-checkout, comparing results.

methods.name: test_all_match
methods.description: Runs a command in full and sparse checkouts, ensuring the outputs match.

methods.name: test_sparse_match
methods.description: Runs a command in sparse setup and asserts success or failure based on expected sparse behavior.

methods.name: test_sparse_unstaged
methods.description: Checks that a specific file in sparse repositories has no unstaged changes.

methods.name: test_sparse_checkout_set
methods.description: Configures sparse checkout with specified cone and sparse directories, then verifies the internal sparse index tree structure.

methods.name: ensure_expanded
methods.description: Runs a command and ensures the index is expanded to full form afterward.

methods.name: ensure_not_expanded
methods.description: Runs a command and verifies that the index remains in sparse form afterward.
